classification.difficultyReason: 1G Q18: Linked familiar operations with signs, exact values or endpoint/domain checks. Pages 34–35 supply the square-completion method; page 37 explicitly rejects a square equal to a negative number.

answer.short:
No real solutions.

Completing the square gives $(x-2)^2=-17$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}(x-2)^2+17&=0\\(x-2)^2&=-17\end{align*}$$
A real square cannot be negative, so there are no real solutions.
